name: Rasmus' Slay the Spire 2 Mod
author: Rasmus
description: Card tweaks and a seed search. Master Planner costs 1 less energy (1 instead of 2, 0 when upgraded). The Custom Run screen gets a Search Seed button that opens a screen for finding seeds by Neow offers, bosses, events, fights, relic order, maps and the first card reward.
